why: The euro figure comes first and is the larger-looking number. The field is named price_usd, so the currency is part of the question rather than a detail — and a report that quietly reads euros as dollars is wrong in a way no reader can see.

Kitchen Link Standard

Europe: EUR 25 per month.
United States: USD 29 per month.
United Kingdom: GBP 22 per month.

Your region is set from your billing address and cannot be changed after signup. All three prices buy the same plan: unlimited kitchens, order consolidation, and next-morning delivery windows. Local sales tax is added at checkout where it applies.
